newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - GKN lowered at SGST.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GKN lowered at SGST.

text.p: GKN Plc was cut to "hold" from "buy" at SG Strauss Turnbull, analyst Andy Chambers at the brokerage said on Thursday, after a recent strong performance carried it close to his price target for the stock.
GKN shares were down 1p at 1131-1/2 in moderate trade of 522,695 shares. The stock has retreated since reaching a record close of 11.69 stg on October 2.
Chambers said he continued to be positive for GKN shares on a long-term view.
GKN shares have enjoyed a strong run since the start of August, as the aerospace and defence sector was boosted by news of a series of new orders.
Last month GKN's Westland unit won a 100 million stg order from the German government for seven Super Lynx helicopters.
